correctness.rationale: For every k≥2, n_i≥2, the graph is connected with v=sum n_i vertices, e=sum n_i n_j edges. Lemma 2.2 gives r0 v isolated vertices and r1 graph wedge^{e−v+1} S1. For x in P_i, radius-one neighborhood is V\(P_i\{x}), so r2 simplex condition is |σ∩P_i|≤1 for SOME i. This proves exact cover T_k=union_i (Δ_1*…*D_i*…*Δ_k). With T_1=D_1, the induction T_j=(T_(j−1)*Δ_j) ∪ ((Δ_1*…*Δ_(j−1))*D_j) has contractible pieces, intersection T_(j−1)*D_j, yielding via cofibration homotopy pushout T_j≃Σ(T_(j−1)*D_j), hence T_k≃Σ^{k−1}(D_1*…*D_k)≃wedge^{prod(n_i−1)}S^{2k−2}. The join reduced-chain Künneth and natural Mayer–Vietoris boundaries under part-preserving permutations identify integral top homology with tensor_i ker(Z^{n_i}→Z), with no interpart permutation signs. Any edge between parts has N1[u]∪N1[v]=V, so r3 full simplex, and only integer thresholds matter. Integral free barcodes follow. All-scale small tuples independently exhaustively reconstructed and mod2 boundary-reduced (checks do not replace unbounded pushout induction).
